x: The Surrey race, held at Epsom, provided us with our fourth successive win, and once again we supplied the individual champion. We has expected to do both of these things, but Arthur Penny had a gruelling race with S.
Stan Belton and Len Herbert kept with him throughout and although the former was dropped over the last two hundred yards, Herbert only got by Olney down the finishing straight.

Actually, our total of points was less than last year when we won the race, but seeing that this was Surrey's first success since 1932, when incidentally both Stan Belton and Tom Carter were in the respective teams, and were still in this year's, I am sure that no one will begrudge Surrey their success.
Herbert, all Belgrave, S.Belton of Surrey AC, ... and A.
